title: judge-prompt-skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/judge-prompt-skeleton.md.j2 and templates/judge-prompt-skeleton.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from judge-prompt-skeleton.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

input.title: Input
input.description: Which case input is being judged? The eval runner substitutes one per invocation - fill it only when rendering this judge for a single case by hand.

label_a.title: Label a
label_a.description: What is the positive label called - the one word the judge emits when the behaviour is present? Pick a word that names the behaviour, not a verdict like 'good'.

label_b.title: Label b
label_b.description: What is the negative label called? It must be mutually exclusive with the positive one; two labels that can both be true is the commonest reason a judge fails calibration.

model_output.title: Model output
model_output.description: What did the system under test produce for that input? Verbatim, and never a case that also appears in holdout.jsonl - r5 forbids contaminating the judge with its own test set.
